# Al-Birru Primary School (SD Al-Birru Sukabumi)

> Official website for Al-Birru Primary School (SD Al-Birru), an integrated Islamic primary school in Cicantayan, Sukabumi, West Java, Indonesia. NPSN: 70010111. BAN-SM Accreditation: Grade A.

## About

Al-Birru Primary School is an integrated Islamic primary school that cultivates noble character (adab), Qur'anic memorization (tahfidz) of minimum 3 mutqin juz with verified sanad, and applied science literacy. We maintain a focused 1:15 teacher-student ratio with a maximum of 20 students per class.

## Core Programs

- **Tahfidzul Qur'an**: 3 mutqin juz memorization with verified sanad through daily halaqah sessions
- **Character Development (Adab)**: Daily congregational prayers, 5S culture (Senyum, Salam, Sapa, Sopan, Santun), birrul walidain projects
- **Applied Science & STEM**: Nature science inquiry, computational thinking, junior coding (Scratch)
- **Bilingual Communication**: Arabic and English language enrichment

## Key Information

- **School ID (NPSN)**: 70010111
- **Accreditation**: Grade A (BAN-SM National Accreditation Board)
- **Location**: Kp. Cisande RT 006/002, Cijalingan, Cicantayan, Sukabumi, West Java 43155, Indonesia
- **Curriculum**: Kurikulum Merdeka (National Freedom Curriculum)
- **Operating Hours**: Monday–Friday, 07:15–15:00 WIB
